mechanism: Modafinil is a CYP3A4 inducer that may reduce amlodipine plasma concentrations, potentially decreasing antihypertensive efficacy; modafinil may also increase cardiovascular stimulation in patients on vasodilators.
action: Monitor blood pressure regularly during concurrent use; consider amlodipine dose adjustment if blood pressure control becomes inadequate; counsel patient on modafinil's stimulant effects.
